flow_title: Statement day and reminder letter settings
flow_summary: Settings fix the day of the month for customer statements and control reminder letters: whether they are sent, the smallest balance that gets one, and the days late at which letters go out.
flow_purpose: Lets the business set when statements are produced and when overdue customers are reminded, without changing code. The business team describes these as reminder letter settings.
starts_when: Each time the accounts receivable module reads its settings, for statements and reminder letters.
outputs: Day of the month for statements
Decision whether a reminder letter is sent
Days late at which each letter is sent
flow_questions_for_sme: Which program reads these settings? No code in this module uses them, so how they are applied is not shown.

flow_steps.text: Statements are produced on day 5 of the month
Send a letter at 30, 60 and 90 days late

scenarios.title: Reminder letters sent at 30, 60 and 90 days
scenarios.outcome: The customer gets a letter at each of 30, 60 and 90 days late.

steps: 60 days late: the second letter is due

scenarios.title: Reminder letters switched off
when: The reminder letter switch is set to false.
scenarios.outcome: No reminder letters are sent to any customer.

scenarios.title: Balance too small for a letter
scenarios.outcome: The customer is not sent a reminder letter.

requirements.text: The system shall produce customer statements on day 5 of each month.
The system shall send reminder letters only when the reminder letter switch is on.
The system shall not send a reminder letter for a balance below 25.00.
The system shall send reminder letters at 30, 60 and 90 days late.

rules.title: Statement day of the month
rules.what_it_does: Sets day 5 of each month as the day customer statements are produced.
rules.business_reason: Statements go out on one fixed day each month. The setting name suggests this; no comment confirms it.
questions_for_sme: What happens when day 5 is a weekend or holiday? Is the statement run moved?

rules.title: Reminder letters on or off
rules.what_it_does: Switches reminder letters on (true) or off for all customers.
rules.business_reason: The business team says the module holds the reminder letter settings. Why a switch is needed is not stated.
when_it_applies: Before any reminder letter is considered.

steps: Switch is true, so letters are allowed

questions_for_sme: Why can letters be switched off, and who decides? No code in this module reads the switch.

rules.title: Minimum balance for a reminder letter
rules.what_it_does: Sets 25.00 as the balance below which no reminder letter is sent.
rules.business_reason: Not known from the code. It probably avoids letters for very small balances, but this is not shown.

steps: 25.00 against 25.00: whether it counts is not known

questions_for_sme: Is a balance of exactly 25.00 sent a letter? What currency is the limit in, and is it per invoice or per customer?

rules.title: Days late at which letters are sent
rules.what_it_does: Sets three letter points: 30, 60 and 90 days late.
rules.business_reason: Not known from the code. Letters at growing delays suggest escalating reminders, but this is not shown.
when_it_applies: The balance is not below the minimum.
questions_for_sme: Are the days counted from the invoice date or the due date? Is the wording of each letter different?

glossary.business_meaning: Reminder letters sent to customers who have not paid
Smallest balance that gets a reminder letter
Days late at which each reminder letter is sent
